task.question: Which film did Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle surpass to become the highest-grossing international film ever released in North America?
task.evidence: the highest-grossing international film in the U.S. (previously held by 2000's Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon)
task.page: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba – The Movie: Infinity Castle

answer:
Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle surpassed "Spider-Man: No Way Home" to become the highest-grossing international film ever released in North America. 

FINAL: Spider-Man: No Way Home
